about: List prices in US dollars per million tokens, one entry per model id, read by scripts/lib/prices.py. Each entry carries its five component prices, the date they were confirmed in force at the source (effective) and where they were read (source). Anthropic first-party API rates: Amazon Bedrock and Vertex AI price separately, and US-only inference (inference_geo) multiplies every component by 1.1 on Claude 4.6 and later models; OpenAI's for the models behind Codex CLI and OpenCode's for its Console (Zen) models, each from that provider's own page, where a component the provider does not bill separately carries the rate it bills it at. premium_request is GitHub's price of one Copilot premium request, beside the token prices and never summed into them. A model not listed is reported as not priced, never as free. A project adds a model or replaces one under pricing.models in sdlc-studio/.config.yaml (reference-config.md#pricing).

models.note: cache read is 0.05x input per the page's footnote 2
the introductory $2/$10 is now the standard price (footnote 3)

prompts up to 100,000 tokens; a prompt over that is $0.50 input, $2.50 output, $0.05 cache read, $0.625 and $1 cache write, which a session total cannot apply per prompt. Matches Claude Code's own costUSD for a captured 2026-11-06 session
